visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a hand with pale skin turning a golden ornate door handle and pushing open a wooden door to reveal a brightly lit interior hallway. This is followed by a digital screen recording of Google Maps showing Ireland with pink heart markers scattered across the map. A group of four young people wave and smile enthusiastically at the camera in front of a blue bus labeled 'Aircoach'. (2) Sequential scenes show various individuals at an airport, including a girl sleeping across airport lounge chairs and another girl waving towards the camera. A woman in a white coat is seen carrying a large beige hard-shell suitcase up a steep, carpeted staircase inside a building. A girl wearing a white sweatshirt and a blue backpack exits a red brick building while holding a stuffed rabbit toy. (3) A close-up of a grey car door shows extensive scratching and denting marked with white chalk notations like 'SCRATCH HEAVY'. People are then shown at an outdoor bus stop loading pink and silver suitcases onto a metal trolley. The main character, a girl with long dark hair, is seen inside a terminal walking through wide corridors and later sitting in a restaurant drinking a dark Guinness beer and eating snacks. (4) Onboard a plane, the girl is seen wearing a black mask and white headphones, holding a small yellow crocheted duck. The video cuts to a view from the airplane window showing a landscape of waterways and fields. A video call on a smartphone shows a girl smiling at the camera. The final scenes depict the girl on a long-haul KLM Asia flight, crocheting a white object and monitoring the flight progress on the seatback display before arriving in Taipei to eat a bowl of rice.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a travel diary documenting the final leg of a 16-day trip through Ireland and the long journey home to Taiwan. It emphasizes the transitions between locations—hotels, buses, airports, and airplanes—while capturing personal moments like crocheting on the flight and the first meal upon returning home.
